sources.title: what is the single tallest building in the world
sources.snippet: The tallest building in the world, as of 2026, is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. · For thousands of years, the Great Pyramid in Egypt was the tallest structure in the world until Lincoln Cathedral of 1311, but the Great Pyramid is not considered a building since it is not habitable. · It is in this sense of being regularly inhabited or occupied that the term "building" is generally applied when determining the world's tallest building.
